import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean NO2 for June 2025 for all stations
query = text("""
SELECT aqs.name_en AS station_name, aqs.id AS station_id,
       AVG(hsq.no2) AS mean_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsq.datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsq.datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en
ORDER BY mean_no2 DESC
""")
mean_no2_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(mean_no2_df)

query = text("""
SELECT luz.land_category,
       SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(luz.geometry, buf.geom))) AS intersect_area_m2
FROM land_use_zone luz,
     (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(114.1701, 22.3203), 4326)::geography, 500)::geometry AS geom) buf
WHERE ST_Intersects(luz.geometry, buf.geom)
GROUP BY luz.land_category
ORDER BY intersect_area_m2 DESC
""")

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

lon, lat = 114.168272, 22.322611

# 1) Dominant land_category within 500m buffer (by intersection area)
query = text(f"""
SELECT luz.land_category,
       SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(luz.geometry, buf.geom))) AS intersect_area_m2
FROM land_use_zone luz,
     (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326)::geography, 500)::geometry AS geom) buf
WHERE ST_Intersects(luz.geometry, buf.geom)
GROUP BY luz.land_category
ORDER BY intersect_area_m2 DESC
""")
landuse_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Land categories within 500m buffer:")
print(landuse_df)

# 2) Count HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas with centroid within 1000m
query = text(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS health_count
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
  AND ST_DWithin(
      ST_Centroid(geometry)::geography,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326)::geography,
      1000
  )
""")
health_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nHealthcare institutions within 1000m:")
print(health_df)

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

lon, lat = 114.168272, 22.322611

# Use geometry-based approach with ST_Area on geometry (degrees) - relative ranking is valid
# Also try a simpler query with ST_Intersects on geometry only
query = text(f"""
SELECT luz.land_category,
       SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(luz.geometry, buf.geom))) AS intersect_area_deg
FROM land_use_zone luz,
     (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326)::geometry, 0.0045) AS geom) buf
WHERE ST_Intersects(luz.geometry, buf.geom)
GROUP BY luz.land_category
ORDER BY intersect_area_deg DESC
""")
# 0.0045 degrees ~= 500m at 22°N
landuse_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Land categories within ~500m buffer (degree-based):")
print(landuse_df)
